Broken page

Second heading that should be an h2

This page is intentionally broken so the auditor has something to detect. It has no canonical link, no lang attribute, no viewport meta, two H1 elements and an invalid JSON-LD block. It loads a render-blocking stylesheet and a synchronous script from the head, and the image has no alt text.

There is no Open Graph block, the hreflang set has no x-default, and the French version does not link back. Internal links below point at a French page, two near-identical service pages and a URL that does not exist in the build. The word count is enough for the page to count as content, so the thin-content rule is not what is being tested here.
